statement: WITH base AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories, array_contains(topic_categories, 'Lifestyle_(sociology)') AS has_lifestyle, array_contains(topic_categories, 'Entertainment') AS has_entertainment FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_channel_labels_20260612 WHERE topic_category_count > 0), parent_base AS (SELECT * FROM base WHERE has_lifestyle OR has_entertainment), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_parent_union_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_lifestyle THEN channel_id END) AS n_lifestyle_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_entertainment THEN channel_id END) AS n_entertainment_channels FROM parent_base), edge_children AS (SELECT child_label, collect_set(parent_label) AS empirical_parents FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_inferred_edges_20260612 WHERE parent_label IN ('Lifestyle_(sociology)', 'Entertainment') AND edge_strength IN ('strong_empirical_parent', 'moderate_empirical_parent') GROUP BY child_label), child_presence AS (SELECT b.channel_id, b.has_lifestyle, b.has_entertainment, e.child_label, e.empirical_parents FROM parent_base b INNER JOIN edge_children e ON array_contains(b.topic_categories, e.child_label)), child_counts AS (SELECT e.child_label, e.empirical_parents, MAX(t.n_parent_union_channels) AS n_parent_union_channels, MAX(t.n_lifestyle_channels) AS n_lifestyle_channels, MAX(t.n_entertainment_channels) AS n_entertainment_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT p.channel_id) AS n_child_union_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.has_lifestyle THEN p.channel_id END) AS n_child_lifestyle_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.has_entertainment THEN p.channel_id END) AS n_child_entertainment_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT p.channel_id) / MAX(t.n_parent_union_channels) AS prevalence_in_parent_union, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.has_lifestyle THEN p.channel_id END) / MAX(t.n_lifestyle_channels) AS prevalence_in_lifestyle, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.has_entertainment THEN p.channel_id END) / MAX(t.n_entertainment_channels) AS prevalence_in_entertainment FROM edge_children e CROSS JOIN totals t LEFT JOIN child_presence p ON e.child_label = p.child_label GROUP BY e.child_label, e.empirical_parents), qualified AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GREATEST(prevalence_in_lifestyle, prevalence_in_entertainment) DESC, prevalence_in_parent_union DESC, child_label) AS prevalence_rank FROM child_counts WHERE GREATEST(prevalence_in_lifestyle, prevalence_in_entertainment) > 0.01), child_pairs AS (SELECT a.channel_id, a.child_label AS child_a, b.child_label AS child_b FROM child_presence a INNER JOIN child_presence b ON a.channel_id = b.channel_id), pair_counts AS (SELECT qa.child_label AS child_a, qb.child_label AS child_b, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.channel_id) AS n_both_channels FROM qualified qa CROSS JOIN qualified qb LEFT JOIN child_pairs cp ON qa.child_label = cp.child_a AND qb.child_label = cp.child_b GROUP BY qa.child_label, qb.child_label) SELECT qa.prevalence_rank AS row_rank, qb.prevalence_rank AS col_rank, qa.child_label AS label_a, qb.child_label AS label_b, array_join(qa.empirical_parents, '|') AS role_a, array_join(qb.empirical_parents, '|') AS role_b, qa.n_parent_union_channels AS denominator_channels, qa.n_lifestyle_channels, qa.n_entertainment_channels, qa.n_child_union_channels AS n_a_channels, qb.n_child_union_channels AS n_b_channels, qa.n_child_lifestyle_channels AS n_a_lifestyle_channels, qa.n_child_entertainment_channels AS n_a_entertainment_channels, qb.n_child_lifestyle_channels AS n_b_lifestyle_channels, qb.n_child_entertainment_channels AS n_b_entertainment_channels, pc.n_both_channels, qa.prevalence_in_parent_union AS prevalence_a, qb.prevalence_in_parent_union AS prevalence_b, qa.prevalence_in_lifestyle AS prevalence_a_in_lifestyle, qa.prevalence_in_entertainment AS prevalence_a_in_entertainment, qb.prevalence_in_lifestyle AS prevalence_b_in_lifestyle, qb.prevalence_in_entertainment AS prevalence_b_in_entertainment, pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_parent_union_channels AS joint_prevalence, pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_child_union_channels AS conditional_b_given_a, pc.n_both_channels / qb.n_child_union_channels AS conditional_a_given_b, pc.n_both_channels / (qa.n_child_union_channels + qb.n_child_union_channels - pc.n_both_channels) AS jaccard, (pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_parent_union_channels) / NULLIF(qa.prevalence_in_parent_union * qb.prevalence_in_parent_union, 0) AS lift_vs_independence FROM qualified qa CROSS JOIN qualified qb INNER JOIN pair_counts pc ON qa.child_label = pc.child_a AND qb.child_label = pc.child_b ORDER BY qa.prevalence_rank, qb.prevalence_rank
